hero.title: Wholesale & Industrial Distribution (CRT)
hero.text: We manage end-to-end fuel deliveries for industrial clients: contracts & price lists, credit limits, route planning, tank telemetry, delivery confirmation and automatic invoicing – integrated with ERP and e-Invoice.
hero.imageAlt: Wholesale and industrial operations with CRT management

capabilities.title: What the PetroSol solution includes for wholesale & industrial
capabilities.subtitle: Operational automation, traceability and financial control – from contract to cash.

features.title: Contracts & pricing
features.desc: Client price lists, clauses, indexations, taxes/discounts, validity periods and credit limits.

features.title: Delivery planning
features.desc: Orders, tank loading, terminal slots, routes and driver/vehicle allocation.

features.title: Routes & execution
features.desc: Navigation, geo check-ins, timings, photo proofs and signature/OTP for POD.

features.title: Telemetry & measurements
features.desc: Flow meters, in-tank probes (ATG), temperature; quantity reconciliation at load/unload.

features.title: Invoicing & e-Invoice
features.desc: Automatic contract-based calculation, excise/taxes, invoice generation and ANAF submission.

features.title: ERP integration
features.desc: Partner, items, orders, invoices sync; open API for third-party systems.

flow.title: How it works
steps: Define the contract, price list and limits (credit, volume).
Receive the client order and plan the route & loading slot.
Truck is loaded; quantity/temperature data captured automatically.
Delivery executed; POD (signature/OTP/photo) and coordinates collected.
Quantities reconciled and invoice issued; data sent to ERP and e-Invoice.

components.title: What we support
hardware: Certified flow meters/counters and in-tank ATG probes
GPS/telematics for fleets and safety sensors
Driver mobile terminal with POD app (photo/signature/OTP)
software: Contracts, price lists and taxation policies
Digital POD, photos and documents attached to delivery

security.title: Security & compliance
points: Role-based access control, audit trail and encryption in transit/at rest.
Data retention policies and alerts for operational deviations.
Processes aligned with ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 27001.

hero.title: Unattended Fuel Stations
hero.text: 24/7 operation without on-site staff: user/vehicle identification, secure payment, pump authorization, real-time monitoring and automated reporting. We integrate field hardware with the PetroSol software platform for control and scale.

capabilities.title: What the PetroSol solution offers
capabilities.subtitle: Everything you need for safe, automated 24/7 operation.

features.title: 24/7 payments
features.desc: Bank card, contactless (Apple/Google Pay) and fleet card with automatic reconciliation.

features.title: Secure identification
features.desc: RFID/PIN for driver or vehicle with limits, time bands and consumption rules.

features.title: Pump & stock control
features.desc: Real-time authorization, exception locking, tank levels & temperature (ATG).

features.title: Video surveillance
features.desc: Events correlated with images (start/stop, declines, alarms) for audit.

features.title: Full integration
features.desc: ERP, e-Invoice, fleet card, telemetry and centralised reporting.

features.desc: Equipment status, network drops, threshold breaches – real-time notifications.

flow.title: How it works
steps: User identifies (RFID/PIN/card) at the terminal.
System checks rights & limits and authorises the pump.
Fueling occurs; transaction data collected.
Transaction closes and is sent to backend / ERP.
Reports, alerts and video images attach to key events.
